name: skills
description: Portable agent skills, installable as Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Rewrite prose so it is precise, readable, and naturally human. English by default; Czech, Slovak, Polish, German, and Ukrainian on request. Removes common AI-writing patterns.

plugins.name: diagram-design
plugins.description: Create branded diagrams as standalone HTML/SVG/PNG in 27 visual types, with brand onboarding and draw.io/Mermaid import.

plugins.name: test-discipline
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic test hygiene: severity-graded reviews that mark tests OK / FIX / DELETE / MISSING.

plugins.name: write-prompt
plugins.description: Write, improve, or translate a prompt: repository context, model-specific guidance from official documentation, and a mandatory independent review.

plugins.name: video-proof
plugins.description: Record a verified Playwriter video that demonstrates a completed fix or story, with build provenance, artifact validation, and Git safety checks.
